info.title: Portway backend — foundation
info.description: Control API with execution state, durable SSE replay and bounded seven-day execution history retention. Run admission intentionally returns 503 until Runtime, capabilities and dispatch fencing are implemented. Execution read/stop/events routes require the execution profile. Approval read/decision, server expiry and stop invalidation are implemented. Model/tool dispatch, Runtime grants, MCP, FCM and packages remain unimplemented. Full readyz stays 503.

get.description: Authenticate with Authorization and X-Device-Session headers only. Use either Last-Event-ID or cursor, never both; omitted cursor starts at 0. SSE id is run UUID:seq, event is RunEvent.type, data is RunEvent JSON. Supports run.created/run.state_changed and approval_requested/approval.resolved. Comment heartbeats have no id. Each page rechecks live authorization; failure closes the stream, and reconnect returns an HTTP error. Expired history is rejected before 200. Bounded polling interval 1 second, heartbeat 10 seconds, stream lifetime 30 minutes, four streams per API process. Does not create runs or expose task/instructions.
